sensitive_data_rule: P01/P05 registries must expose public-safe projections only; PII/internal finance/operations are not general Studio-bindable
fail_closed_rule: missing/unpublished/unauthorized/unavailable targets must hide, disable, fallback deterministically or block publish; never invent business state
audit_rule: all future Studio mutations/actions/assignments must use existing audit/event authorities and add origin metadata rather than create a shadow audit ledger
permission_rule: every future source/action descriptor declares read/execute/manage permissions where applicable
